entries.title: Psalms 51:1
segments:
My transgressions; especially his sins in the matter of Uriah, with which he was charged by the prophet Nathan, and of which he was now deeply sensible. 
 
All the hope of the true penitent is in the free mercy and rich grace of God, and these form his only plea before him.

entries.title: Psalms 51:4
segments:
Against thee, thee only; his sin was principally, or especially against God, and most aggravated in his sight. 
 
  Be justified--and be clear when thou judgest; clear from all wrong in condemning him. 
 
However greatly any one injures his fellow men by his sins, their chief guilt is in being committed against God.

entries.title: Psalms 51:6
segments: Truth in the inward parts; purity, sincerity, and uprightness of soul.

entries.title: Psalms 51:7
segments:
Hyssop; a plant or shrub used in external cleansing, and emblem of internal purity. 
 
Purification from sin is the work of the Holy Spirit, and to him the believer looks for this inestimable blessing.

entries.title: Psalms 51:8
segments: The bones which thou hast broken; that the distresses brought upon him might be removed.

entries.title: Psalms 51:11
segments: Without the constant aid of the Holy Spirit, even the most eminent believers will be in constant danger of falling into the most aggravated sins.

entries.title: Psalms 51:12
segments:
The joy of thy salvation; which he had lost by his sins. 
 
  Uphold me; without this he would again fall into sin.

entries.title: Psalms 51:13
segments: It is only when we have the joy of God's salvation in our own hearts, that we are qualified to guide sinners to repentance.  The believer desires God's presence and the light of his countenance, not for his own sake alone, but for the sake of his fellow men.

entries.title: Psalms 51:14
segments: Bloodguiltiness; in procuring the death of Uriah.

entries.title: Psalms 51:15
segments: For a heart to praise God men are dependent on him, and they should continually look up to him for this inestimable blessing.

entries.title: Psalms 51:17
segments: The sacrifices of God; the offerings which are pleasing to him and which he will accept.

entries.title: Psalms 51:18
segments:
Zion; the church of God. 
 
The sincere penitent desires spiritual blessings not only for himself but for others, especially for the people of God in every part of the world.

entries.title: Psalms 51:19
segments: Sacrifices of righteousness; such as God requires.
